## Professional Positioning

Amul Sharma is developing toward a career combining backend software engineering, AI application development, Django/DRF, AI-integrated web applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), machine-learning applications, cloud deployment, and cybersecurity-aware software development. His preferred career direction is applied AI/software engineering rather than a purely theoretical or mathematics-heavy data-science career.

The strongest current professional positioning is: **Backend Software Engineer with an applied AI specialization**, at the intersection of Python + Django + APIs + Databases + Cloud + AI/RAG.

## Core Technical Skills

- Backend: Python, Django, Django REST Framework, REST APIs, Serializers, ViewSets, Routers, JWT authentication, Permissions, RBAC, Filtering, Pagination, Database indexing, Celery, Redis, Security middleware, Automated testing
- Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui
- Databases: SQLite, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
- AI/ML: Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forest, KNN, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, SHAP, Optuna, RandomizedSearchCV, cross-validation, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, MCC, imbalanced classification, threshold tuning, SMOTENC, RAG, PEFT, embeddings, vector databases
- Cloud/Infrastructure: Microsoft Azure (VNets, Subnets, NSGs, Load Balancing, NAT Gateway, VM Scale Sets, Azure SQL, Autoscaling), Ubuntu, Nginx, GitHub, Render, Vercel

## Major Projects

- [Job Sarathi](https://github.com/CODE-WITH-AMUL/jobSarathi): Job-management/recruitment platform (Django backend, React/Vite/TypeScript frontend) with Company and Candidate roles, job postings, applications, ownership-based authorization, and application lifecycle management (applied, under_review, shortlisted, rejected, selected, withdrawn).
- [PromtMarket](https://github.com/CODE-WITH-AMUL/PromtMarket): Django web application deployed on Render ([live](https://promtmarket.onrender.com)), exploring PostgreSQL/Supabase and MongoDB/Djongo deployment architectures.
- ePharmacy: Django-based pharmacy management application with custom authentication, Admin/Employee/Customer roles, user profiles, Nepal province/district data, email verification, persistent authentication, and Jazzmin administration.
- FinCore: ERP/accounting-oriented SaaS project for startups and small businesses, covering income management, invoices, expenses, tax/VAT, investments, profit and loss, cash flow, and editable audit-report templates.

## Machine Learning Projects

- Heart Attack Prediction: Large-scale heart-attack prediction dataset (youth and adults in America), comparing Logistic Regression, LightGBM, CatBoost, Decision Tree, Random Forest, and KNN, with a focus on class imbalance, SHAP explainability, hyperparameter optimization, and threshold/PR/ROC/MCC analysis. CatBoost is of particular interest.
- Tuberculosis Prediction: Real-world tuberculosis dataset analysis using XGBoost, focused on dataset quality, feature analysis, target definition, and real-world healthcare data considerations.

## Research

- "Empirical Evaluation of RAG and PEFT for Efficient and Reliable Domain-Specific LLMs": Evaluates efficient methods for domain-specific language-model systems, covering RAG, PEFT, cybersecurity knowledge domains, PDF/JSON sources, embeddings, and vector databases, using small/open models (Phi-3 Mini, OPT-125M, TinyLlama) rather than proprietary LLMs.
- "Impact of Cybersecurity Practices on the Adoption of AI in Small Businesses, Kathmandu": Uses the Technology-Organization-Environment (TOE) framework to study AI adoption and cybersecurity practices among small businesses in the Kathmandu Valley, with quantitative (SPSS) and thematic analysis.

## Cloud Computing

Azure-based coursework covering Resource Groups, Virtual Networks, Web/App/Database subnet architecture, NSGs, Public Load Balancers, NAT Gateway, VM Scale Sets, Nginx, Azure SQL, autoscaling, Ubuntu, GitHub, and Vercel.
